name: My Master's Birthday
source:
You play as a werewolf butler named Damien. It's October 31st, and he wants to impress his master, Victoria, by buying her her favorite foods for her birthday!

[From [url=https://bosimba.itch.io/my-masters-birthday]Itch.io[/url]]
